observations: A black game console with rounded corners, characteristic of the PlayStation 4 Slim model.
The PlayStation 'PS' logo is visible in the center of the top/side panel in photo 0.
One black DualShock 4 controller is resting on the console.
The console is positioned vertically against a wood-paneled wall.
Watermark 'TECHLINK GADGETS STORE' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' is present on the image.
The seller misspells the brand as 'Sonny'.

claims.evidence: The console appears physically intact in photo 0, but only one side is visible; ports, vents, and the other side are hidden.
There are no photos of the system software, library, or storage menu to confirm installed content.
One DualShock 4 controller is visible in photo 0.

risks.risk: The console may not power on, output video (HDMI port damage), or may have a Blue Light of Death (BLOD).
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the PlayStation home screen and launching a game.

risks.risk: The internal storage capacity is unknown (could be 500GB or 1TB).
risks.proof: A photo of the 'Settings > Storage' screen.

risks.risk: Installed games may be tied to a personal account that will be removed or locked after purchase.
risks.proof: A photo of the game library showing no 'lock' icons and confirmation that the account is included.

risks.risk: The controller may have stick drift or unresponsive buttons.
risks.proof: A video of the controller being used to navigate menus or a button test.

proof_requests: Photo of the console powered on and connected to a screen showing the dashboard.
Photo of the 'Settings > Storage' menu to verify capacity and installed games.
Photos of the back and bottom of the console to check ports and warranty seals.
response.reason: The item is clearly a Sony PlayStation 4 Slim based on the form factor and logo in photo 0. It can be priced at its worst-case value as a non-functional 500GB unit with no games.
